opencode-viewer

A live dashboard of the current OpenCode session, in a tab of OpenCode Desktop's side region: what fills the context, tokens and cost, every request, a trace of each turn, and your tools. Below is the plugin's real UI on a made-up session: hover anything, click a request column or a turn, or replay the session. Install it from GitHub →
